Ivy W.: quick note — ran into a weird ESM/CJS interop that only shows up on our edge runner when using esbuild via vite.
Ivy W.: repo: https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-edge-esbuild-min (internal)
Ivy W.: summary: build as ESM -> works. build as CJS (vite lib formats:['cjs'] or esbuild format:'cjs') -> deployed to edge -> 401 + runtime `TypeError: client.create is not a function`.
Sam K.: does local node cjs also fail or only edge?
Ivy W.: local Node cjs behaves differently (thanks to Node's require resolution) — the failure reproduces only when the edge deployer resolves the CJS entrypoint.
Devin: likely export shape: esbuild's CJS output wraps `default` differently (module.exports = { default: ... }). Edge loader then expects functions on the object.
Ivy W.: minimal repro steps: 
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-edge-esbuild-min && cd repro-edge-esbuild-min
2) npm ci
3) npm run build:cjs  # vite -> lib.formats:['cjs']
4) deploy to edge or run `deno task start:edge`
5) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/_create -> 401 + TypeError
Sam K.: vite config that triggers it?
Ivy W.: small snippet:
```js
// vite.config.js
export default {
  build: {
    lib: { entry: 'src/index.ts', formats: ['cjs'] },
    commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true }
  }
}
```
Devin: quick workarounds: (1) publish ESM-first (set package exports so ESM is preferred), (2) add tiny interop shim at package root: `module.exports = exports.default ? exports.default : exports` — works but ugly.
Ivy W.: action items: add a CI smoke that builds both formats and runs a lightweight edge emulation; update onboarding sample app to default to ESM; add doc note about `commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules`.
